topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
consensus_response: Larger SIW arrays increase gain but reduce radiation efficiency due to higher insertion losses. As array size grows, longer SIW lines amplify these losses, impacting link budget and network capacity. Mitigating substrate material losses can help maintain efficiency.
reference_context: SIW array size affects radiation efficiency, with larger arrays reducing efficiency due to increased insertion losses.
